For short shaft distances, a combination of two two-part coupling hubs and VkR buffer. The rotationally resilient, failsafe claw coupling RINGFEDER TNB series is flexible in all directions and therefore compensates for angular, parallel and axial shaft misalignments of the connected machines. The RINGFEDER TNB BHDDV - coupling is a torsionally flexible, puncture proof claw coupling. It compensates for angular, radial and axial shaft misalignments within defined limits. The coupling transmits torque through elastic buffers loaded in shear. These buffers come in synthetic rubber (Pb) or polyurethane (Vk), as a standard VkR. These elastic buffers dampen shocks and torsional vibrations and are resistant to oil. Features are : Torsionally flexible, compensate for angular, radial and axial shaft misalignment, Buffers loaded in compression, Buffers can be replaced radially without having to move the coupled machines, Elastomers available in various shore hardness degrees, temperature ranges of –30° to +100°C.

The coupling transmits torque through elastic buffers loaded in shear. These buffers come in synthetic rubber (Pb) or polyurethane (Vk), as a standard VkR. These elastic buffers dampen shocks and torsional vibrations and are resistant to oil. Features are : Torsionally flexible, compensate for angular, radial and axial shaft misalignment, Buffers loaded in compression, Buffers can be replaced radially without having to move the coupled machines, Elastomers available in various shore hardness degrees, temperature ranges of –30° to +100°C.

(THREAD = 1 x M3), RINGFEDER GWE jaw coupling has concave jaws on its face. Advantages :nTorques from 0,5 – 650 Nm, Vibration damping, Compensation of radial, axial and angular misalignment.

Applications : Grinding and milling spindles, Linear motion, Test rigs, Feed drives, Textile machinery, Multi-spindle heads, Encoder. Advantages : Backlash-free, through pre-stressing, Pluggable, Vibration damping, Torques from 0,5 – 650 Nm, Electrically isolating.

One part design with ﬂange, externally centred. RINGFEDER TNM LE is a torsionally elastic and puncture-proof jaw coupling with screw-down ﬂange. It balances out angular, radial and axial shaft offset within determined tolerances. RINGFEDER TNM jaw couplings can be used universally in general engineering and are primarily utilised as drive and output couplings for gears, in pumps and screw compressor drives as well as in combined heat and power plants. Features are : Torsionally ﬂexible, compensate for angular, radial and axial shaft misalignment, Pre-compressed individual buffers connected to an inter- mediate ring, Intermediate rings of different Shore hardness levels, Changing of the elastic intermediate ring with movement of the connected aggregates. Advantages : Torsionally ﬂexible, Damping of torsional vibrations, Many variations with modular design. Temperatures from –30°C to +100°C.

One part design with ﬂange, externally centred. RINGFEDER TNM LE is a torsionally elastic and puncture-proof jaw coupling with screw-down ﬂange. Features are : Torsionally ﬂexible, compensate for angular, radial and axial shaft misalignment, Pre-compressed individual buffers connected to an inter- mediate ring, Intermediate rings of different Shore hardness levels, Changing of the elastic intermediate ring with movement of the connected aggregates. Three-part design, to change the intermediate ring without axial movement of the driven parts with flange, externally centred. RINGFEDER TNM LG couplings are torsionally flexible, puncture proof claw couplings. They compensate for angular, radial and axial shaft misalignments within defined limits. The coupling transmits torque through elastic buffers loaded in compression. The rotationally resilient coupling of the RINGFEDER TNM series is flexible in all directions and therefore compensates for angular, parallel and axial shaft misalignments of the connected machines. Features are : Torsionally flexible, compensate for angular, radial and axial shaft misalignment, Intermediate rings loaded in compression, Elastomers various shore hardness degrees. The buffer ring dampens shocks and torsional vibrations. It is resistant to oil and electrically conductive. The direction of rotation can be checked after having retracted the claw ring. It is also possible to radially remove a coupling half. Temperatures from –30°C to +100°C.

The rotationally resilient coupling of the RINGFEDER TNS coupling is flexible in all directions and therefore compensates for angular, parallel and axial shaft misalignments of the connected machines. Features are : Torsionally flexible, compensate for angular, radial and axial shaft offset, Intermediate rings loaded in compression, Elastomers available in various shore hardness degrees. Temperatures from –30°C to +100°C.

Magnaloy Coupling’s full range of flexible inserts permit custom design performance for a wide range of applications. All insert materials offer complete electrical insulation, as Magnaloy’s design eliminates all metal-to-metal contact.

Install the insert in the coupling positioning hubs in contact with lip around outside of insert.

Magnaloy’s insert reduces noise and vibration and permits needed flexibility for proper operation within alignment capabilities.

Magnaloy’s insert design will accept misalignment strain and, when excessive, will cause insert wear as a visual and audible indication of misalignment problems.

Magnaloy is the original lightweight, heavy-duty flexible drive coupling. Light weight magnesium construction makes Magnaloy couplings 76% lighter than cast iron and 36% lighter than aluminum units.

Magnaloy Couplings offer four-way flexibility (parallel, angular, axial and torsional) and require no lubrication. They are easily installed and properly aligned without use of special tools or equipment - a straight edge and hex wrench ar the only tools required. Magnaloy’s insert reduces noise and vibration and permits needed flexibility for proper operation within alignment capabilities.

The benefits are many : Reduced loads on bearings, shafts and pumps, for longer component life. Easier handling and installation. Rust proof and corrosion resistant.

An RSLI 59 RU-Steel coupling is a specific model of flexible, full-steel transmission coupling manufactured by RU-STEEL, designed for high-torque industrial applications requiring flexibility with torsional rigidity. It features a lamellar pack design with flexible elements in stainless steel to connect hubs and a spacer for a balanced, high-efficiency power transmission. This coupling is ATEX certified for use in explosive environments and is engineered to withstand shock and vibration while offering durable, long-lasting performance.

RSLI 59 is a model name within RU-STEEL's range of elastic and flexible transmission couplings. It is a "full steel" coupling, meaning its construction is entirely metallic. The flexible elements are made from stainless steel (e.g., AISI 304), providing flexibility and torsional rigidity.

These bearing is an industrial-grade elastic coupling designed to simplify maintenance by allowing the inspection and replacement of its central elastic member without the need to displace the driving or driven equipment. The \"TB\" designation indicates it is a Taper Bore model, which uses standard taper bushes for quick, secure mounting onto shafts without additional machining. Features are : Taper Lock Integration, Ease of Mounting, Independent Hub Rotation, Zero Lubrication, Radial Replacement, Misalignment Compensation, No-Load Motor Testing, Temperature Versatility, High-Speed Capability. Applications: Pumps and Fluid Handling, Heavy Industrial Processing, Power Generation, Manufacturing Machinery, HVAC and Air Handling, Food and Pharmaceutical, Light Transmission, Paper & Pulp Mills, Textile & Woodworking, Specialized & Hazardous Environments.

Features are : High Peripheral Speed, Misalignment Compensation, Zero-Displacement Inspection, No-Load Motor Testing, Performance & Safety Enhancements, Maintenance-Free Life, Extended Service Life, Extreme Temperature Tolerance, Chemical Resistance. Applications : Material Handling & Lifting, Mining & Quarrying, Paper & Chemical Plants, Textile Machinery, Woodworking Machinery, Crushing & Milling, Steel & Metallurgy, Specialized Testing & Mechanical Systems, Cranes & Hoists, Bucket Wheel Excavators.

These bearing refer to specific components of the Samiflex elastic coupling system, an industrial transmission solution designed for high-performance power transfer without the need for lubrication or shaft movement during maintenance. The system typically consists of four main parts: two identical hubs, a split polyurethane insert, and a retaining ring. The standard yellow insert (95 Shore A hardness) is designed for general use with an operating range of -40°C to 80°C (-40°F to 180°F). The insert is split axially, allowing it to be replaced without moving the motor or the driven machine. These are used in applications requiring a specific distance between shaft ends, such as pump drives where space is needed for mechanical seal maintenance. Features are : Split Insert Technology, No-Fastener Assembly, Independent Hub Rotation, High Misalignment Tolerance, Vibration Damping, Longer Service Life, Operating Stability, No-Load Motor Testing, Bore-to-Torque Efficiency. Applications : Pump and Fluid Handling, Waste Water Treatment, Mining Machinery, Conveyor Systems, Steel and Cement Plants, Compressors and Blowers, Paper and Textile Mills. DF=Disc or Spacer Configuration.

These bearing refers to a specific size and configuration of Samiflex Elastic Couplings, which are high-performance power transmission components. The EB refers to the flywheel coupling version designed for connection to engine flywheels. These bearing is a mid-to-high capacity model within the Samiflex range, known for its ability to allow inspection and replacement of the elastic element without moving the motor or driven equipment. It typically integrates the standard elastic insert and retaining ring but utilizes a specialized hub or flange to meet flywheel mounting standards. The assembly consists of just two hubs, one precision-machined polyurethane insert, and a retaining ring. Features are : Misalignment Compensation, Vibration and Shock Absorption, Spark-Free Design, Silent Operation, Large Bore-to-Torque Ratio, Indefinite Shelf Life, Chemical and Environmental Resilience. Applications : Pumping & Fluid Handling, Compression Systems, Power Generation & Energy, Marine & Transport, Mining and Construction Systems, Textiles & Printing, Conveyor Systems, Waste & Water Management.

These bearing is a specific configuration of the Samiflex elastic coupling designed for SAE flywheel arrangements, commonly used to connect engines to driven equipment. The polyurethane insert is axially split, allowing it to be removed and replaced in minutes by simply sliding back the retaining ring. This eliminates the need to realign or move the machinery. The elastic insert fails, there is no metal-to-metal contact between the hubs, which prevents sparking and enhances safety in explosive (ATEX-rated) environments. Features are : Independent Hub Rotation, No Lubrication Required, Tool-Free Assembly, Misalignment Compensation, Vibration and Shock Damping, Mechanical Isolation, Extended Service Life, Environmental Resistance, High Temperature Performance. Applications : Pumps and Fluid Handling, Compressors and Blowers, Mining and Excavation, Steel and Metal Plants, Paper and Chemical Mills, Marine and Offshore Applications, Environmental and Agricultural Systems.

This samiflex coupling refers to a specific size and type within the Samiflex elastic coupling range, specifically designed as a limited end float coupling for applications like sleeve bearing motors. It is not a bearing itself but a flexible coupling that connects two shafts, such as a motor and a pump, while allowing for easy maintenance without moving either piece of equipment. Material : Typically made of cast iron (GG-25), ductile iron, or cast steel. Applications : Steel and Iron Plants, Power Generation, Precision and Protection, Paper & Pulp Mills, Fluid & Gas Handling, Conveyor Systems, Chemical & Petrochemical, Steel & Metal Works, Power & Marine Applications.
